Sentinels of the Multiverse Alternate Hero Promo Card Pack

http://www.amazon.com/Sentinels-Multiverse-Alternate-Hero-Promo/dp/B00F07QJ1M

 

A telling review of 1 star: 

Seller seems to be taking huge advantage of cards that were given out as goodwill to kickstarter backers and reselling them at an excessive premium.


Please note that the creators of this game (Greater than Games) have given their express permission to anyone who wants to print these cards on their own and play with them for free. All are available here: http://www.spiffworld.com/sotm/printable.cfm You can download them by clicking "Oversize hero HP Trackers" and unzipping that file.

posts.name: Silverleaf
posts.cooked:
If someone's willing to play a particular price for something, I don't see the problem, personally.

I have a small item finishing on eBay this afternoon which I basically just wanted to get a token amount for, partially to get it out of the house (we're decluttering) and partly so it'd go to someone who'd actually want it, so I listed it at £0.99. It's currently up to £15. Someone's going to get something they want for a price they're obviously happy to pay, I get some extra cash and can make a donation to charity. 

I don't see how selling something you own that someone could buy somewhere else is a scam, or fraudulent. And telling eBay you want to break a contract you've entered into freely because you could get the item you bought cheaper elsewhere is, in my opinion, ridiculous.

It is true that the amount that are being charged for them is exorbitant given that they were given for free with any order during December, but if people want to pay that much for them, that's their own business.
